attrs.summary: 1st-Degree Droids are usually Medical, Analytical, or Scientific Droids.
2nd-Degree Droids are typically Astromech Droids and some Technical Droids.
3rd-Degree Droids are typically Protocol Droids and Replica Droids.
4th-Degree Droids are Battle Droids, Destroyer Droids, Security Droids, War Droids, Probe Droids, and Assassin Droids.
5th-Degree Droids are typically Utility Droids with low-level functions.
Your skills at observation and stealth are frequently called upon as you gather information about enemy forces.
You are highly trained in medical procedures for all conditions.

availability: Tradition Talent Tree (The Agents of Ossus)
attrs.availability_text: Tradition Talent Tree (The Agents of Ossus)
attrs.summary: The Agents of Ossus are urban Force-users who specialize in using their powers to survive in the cities and towns at the center of civilization. Their proximity to Imperial authority necessitates both discretion and creativity among their members.

The Aing-Tii Monks have an understanding of The Force that is different from The Jedi and most other Force Traditions. The Force has many more aspects than just a Light Side and a Dark Side, and it is most useful for facilitating freedom of travel.
The Force grants you considerable power over your environment as well as others around you.
You have studied the ways of your enemies and have learned how to read the actions and thoughts of others, anticipating their every move.

attrs.availability_text: Soldier, Jedi Knight, Sith Apprentice, Gladiator, Imperial Knight
attrs.summary: You can maximize the benefits of wearing Armor while reducing or eliminating some of its drawbacks.
If ever caught in a straightforward fight, the odds are you are not going to make it, so your best move is to fight dirty and use every trick at your disposal.
You are able to resist any attempts to curb your independence and can fight back against anyone that tries to suppress your personality.

attrs.availability_text: Scout, Bounty Hunter, Gunslinger, Gladiator, Martial Arts Master, Pathfinder, Vanguard
attrs.summary: You are exceptionally good at noticing things and avoiding perilous situations.
The cultists of The Bando Gora have a reputation for being merciless, and you are no exception.

attrs.availability_text:
Tradition Talent Tree
(The Baran Do Sages)
attrs.summary: Kel Dor who become Baran Do Sages are contemplative and insightful, using The Force to unravel the skeins of the past, present, and future to determine the best course of action. They are masters of Farseeing and other Sense-related Force abilities, making them excellent as both investigators and advisors.
You have learned to use The Force to touch the minds of the Beasts, soothing them and convincing them to do your bidding.
The Believers follow the teachings of The Sith from ancient times and strive to extend the influence of The Dark Side of The Force.

Blazing Chain members develop abilities that aid them in raids and Starship combat. They do not rely on Lightsabers, so they apply The Force to blasters and other weapons in ways that other Force Traditions have not attempted.
One of the most valued skills a pilot on the fringe can have is the ability to blast past the authorities and not get caught.
You are trained to work within the famed Bothan SpyNet.
You are among the finest Bounty Hunters in the galaxy, relying on the element of surprise and your hunter's instincts to catch your prey.
You like to get "up close and personal" with your enemies and engage them in melee combat.
You use your experience operating on the wrong side of the law to give you an advantage in a fight, fair or otherwise.
Your brutal fighting techniques give you an upper hand when operating in small groups.
You learn quickly how to blend in with your environment.
Many gunslingers choose to specialize in long arms, especially Blaster Carbines.
Some Nobles learn to work both sides of the conflict in war and can manipulate their enemies into believing they are allies.
You use advanced combat tactics to take down enemies quickly, shield your comrades, and endure whatever challenges are thrown your way.
You have learned how to regulate your own body systems, control your emotions, and channel The Force.
You are an extension of your corporation and wield their power as your own.
Some Elite Troopers know exactly where to strike their foes to deal maximum damage, potentially crippling their enemies in the process.
Your powerful negative emotions allow The Dark Side to flow through you, giving you great power.
The path to The Dark Side of The Force is the quick and easy path, granting amazing power but forever dominating the destines of those in its grasp.

availability: Tradition Talent Tree (The Witches of Dathomir)
attrs.availability_text: Tradition Talent Tree (The Witches of Dathomir)
attrs.summary: The Force-using witches of the planet Dathomir are primitive yet powerful beings. They use ancient training handed down for generations as the basis of their powers.

attrs.availability_text:
Tradition Talent Tree
(The Disciples of Twilight)
attrs.summary: The Disciples of Twilight embody shadow, using The Force to manipulate light and darkness.
Scandal fouls your family name, forcing you to live among the fringes of society and teaching you that honor is overrated when victory is on the line.
You have learned the quirks and intricacies of commanding Droids, and you can get the most out of even the least sophisticated basic programming.

attrs.availability_text: Jedi Knight, Jedi Master, Sith Apprentice, Imperial Knight
attrs.summary: Through rigorous training and experience, you become one of the greatest swordfighters in the galaxy.
You have become a highly advanced Droid and are among the elite units of your class.

attrs.availability_text:
Tradition Talent Tree
(The Ember of Vahl)
attrs.summary: Members of Vahl's cult look to their goddess for inspiration. Over the years, they have developed talents that slant toward the destructive.
You are a trained investigator who can locate and apprehend a quarry with exceptional speed and prowess.
You use your knowledge of stealth and survival to make yourself a master of espionage and a valuable resource for those who wish to keep their hands clean.
You have broken with your family, world, or organization, adapting in new ways to the galaxy at large.
The Ace Pilot relies on finely honed instincts and years of pilot training to outmaneuver and destroy enemy Starships.
Felucian Shamans learn to manipulate their natural aptitude with The Force and amplify their inherent powers in a variety of ways.
In the days of The Old Republic Era, the fine art of swordplay was stylish among Nobles. A particular style arose mixing martial precision with forceful panache.
Force Adepts use The Force to survive on fringe worlds, and they often have signature Force Powers that they use particularly well.
Hunting Jedi is big business during The Legacy Era, and are among the most dangerous prey for Bounty Hunters to pursue.
You can imbue weapons and objects with the power of The Force.
Many Scoundrels like to gamble with destiny, putting everything on the line and trusting fate (or The Force) to bring them fortune, fame, and success.
You're especially skilled at "getting by" on backwater worlds.
When a fighting force is outmanned, outgunned, and constantly on the run, only the skill and acumen of talented Officers can keep morale high and prevent desertion or surrender.
The Gand Findsmen are an ancient order of Force-sensitive Bounty Hunters that interpret signs and portents.
Members of The GenoHaradan are skilled not only in performing assassinations but also in manipulating others.
You have learned the tricks of fighting in the gladiatorial arena, using a specialized combination of combat and showmanship.
You have a spirit watching over you, providing advice and continuing your training in The Force. Although Force Spirits cannot physically aid you, their guidance is critical to your success.
Many Starship Gunners are skilled both in and out of the cockpit and are deadly with ranged Weapons of any kind.
You never travel anywhere without a blaster (or two), and you know how to handle yourself in a gunfight.
You are an experienced deep-space explorer who has learned a few tricks along the way that help you survive both in space and planet-side.
Your zeal and dedication to your cause is inspirational. It motivates your allies and demoralizes your enemies.
Trained to hunt down and destroy the remaining Jedi whenever they are found, Imperial Inquisitors are steeped in the lore of The Dark Side.
Some Shapers develop implants that can be placed quickly and easily, temporarily boosting the physical prowess of their beneficiaries.
You are wanted in multiple systems for criminal acts; and your manner of doing business has earned you an unsavory reputation in the criminal underworld.
You are trained to secretly infiltrate enemy strongholds and organizations by force or by guile.
One of your greatest strengths is your ability to exert influence over your opponents.
You can often get results out of their friends, allies, and followers that other leaders cannot.

The Iron Knights are truly unique, in that they are silicon-based creatures that use Droids as their physical bodies to interact with the galaxy. As a result, they view and utilize The Force in ways that seem unusual to The Jedi. Most of their powers involve their ability to affect Droids and other machinery.
The Jal Shey concentrate on studying The Force, improving their diplomacy, and applying their teachings to their trappings.
You have dedicated your life as a Jedi to preserving knowledge and applying it in times when it is needed.
You have dedicated yourself to the art of creation, learning how to craft Weapons and other items used by The Jedi with exquisite detail.
Jedi Battlemasters are highly trained in Jedi combat techniques, serving combat trainers for Jedi Organizations and as Jedi commanders on the battlefield.
Jedi that follow the path of the consular are skilled negotiators and talented ambassadors.
Jedi that follow the path of the guardian are more combat-oriented than other Jedi, honing their skills to become deadly combatants.
You have focused your natural ability with The Force to heal the sick and injured
The role of teacher is vital to the success and strength of The Jedi Order, and you excel at the art of instruction.
You are one of The Jedi Order's most trusted investigators, tasked with ferreting out truth through a combination of detective work and Force divination.
In The Legacy Era, The Jedi are once again hunted to near-extinction and must learn to conceal their Force Powers and blend in.
The Jedi that follow the path of the sentinel are the true enemies of The Dark Side, hunting down evil and stopping the spread of darkness wherever they go.
Jedi Shadows are often elite Jedi Sentinels who specialize in abilities that aid them in pursuing Dark Side users in all forms and locations.
Jedi Watchmen are elite Jedi tasked with protecting and watching over a specific world or region of space; many beginning as Jedi Consulars.
You have learned to use The Force to master a variety of weapons, and have expanded your martial prowess to cover more than just Lightsabers.
The Jensaarai walk a thin line between light and darkness, using the teachings of both The Jedi and The Sith to create their own unique traditions.
Keetael learn to efficiently and secretly manipulate The Force in combat. Because of their long lives, they gain certain advantages when attempting to view the past through The Force.
You are a skilled master of The Force who knows how to get the most out of your Armor.
You have dedicated your life to serving the rightful Emperor, and your devotion knows no bounds.
You have learned to use Pelekotan to survive in the jungles of Haruun Kal and have bonded with an Akk Dog, which serves you faithfully.
The Krath specialize in experimenting with The Dark Side and Sith sorcery.

attrs.availability_text: Noble, Officer, Corporate Agent, Droid Commander
attrs.summary: A born leader, you know how to change and lead your companions and followers to success.
The Light Side of The Force is not the easiest course to follow, but its promise of peace and harmony can help even the most weak-willed of Force-users on the right path.

attrs.availability_text: Jedi, Jedi Knight, Sith Apprentice, Imperial Knight
attrs.summary: The Lightsaber is the chosen weapon of the Jedi. Not as clumsy or random as a blaster, the Lightsaber is an elegant weapon for a more civilized combatant.
You have refined your knowledge of Lightsaber technique, your blade becoming an extension of yourself.
You lead a privileged life and reap the benefit of an upbringing beyond most citizens of the galaxy.
As a result of your station, occupation, or even just your natural charisma, you can attract one or more faithful Followers who protect you from harm.
The Luka Sene build upon the natural Miralukan sense-based abilities.
You can employ a wide array of lethal toxins with which you can quickly and efficiently destroy your targets.
The Mandalorians are talented and ferocious warriors. Their skillful training, warrior culture, and advanced combat abilities make them formidable foes.
You have advanced training in one or more martial art forms, turning your body into a lethal weapon.
You are a skilled manipulator and have mastered the art of working behind the scenes to accomplish your goals.

records.name: Master of Teras Kasi Talent Tree

attrs.summary: Teras Kasi is a powerful and deadly martial arts form that enables its wielder to deal devastating amounts of Unarmed damage.
You are more experienced and talented than the average Scout. You draw upon your diverse abilities to gain advantages others cannot match.
You have the ability to attract loyal Minions and are skilled at redirecting allies on the battlefield.
All Matukai strive to achieve harmony between the physical and the spiritual aspects of their lives. As a result, they find ways to use The Force in improve their bodies.
You are lethal when fighting with one or more melee weapons.
Your skill with hand-to-hand combat is unmatched, and you can wield weapons with lethal accuracy and power.
Mercenaries are blasters-for-hire who sell their services to the highest bidder. Few types of Soldiers are more capable of operating independently.
You have become skilled at using and manipulating technology on the battlefield. In fact, your fellows rely on your technical expertise in the heat of battle.
You are an expert at leading troops into battle and using the battlefield to your advantage.
Your mother always said you were trouble. Now your enemies know it, too.
Always mobile, Scouts have developed ways to ride and drive over all types of terrain.
You have studied The Force in a radically different way from other Force-users, relying on rituals and mystic lore to harness its power.
You are skilled at commanding Starships and small fleets.
Profiteers, gunrunners, and privateers can use the chaos of war to make a tidy profit, and you are no exception.

availability: Tradition Talent Tree (The Order of Shasa)
attrs.availability_text: Tradition Talent Tree (The Order of Shasa)
attrs.summary: The Order of Shasa is still developing training techniques and abilities, taking most of their influence from Manaan's oceans.
As an Outlaw, you live under a shadow, and everywhere you go, any time you reveal yourself, you risk being noticed and captured.
Scoundrels learn a variety of tricks that allow them to squeeze more life out of ailing technology, enhancing their gear in ways the manufacturer never intended.
By blurring the line between lawful and lawless, Scoundrels operate outside social and cultural norms, learning to make the most of their positions.
You can take direct control over your Droid allies for brief periods.
You use devious tactics to capture ships and victims intact.
You are a master of wielding two Pistols at the same time, and can use both Pistols simultaneously in unusual ways.
You are a veteran of privateering and have learned the secrets of fighting aboard Starships.
You are specially trained to protect those around you, either by taking the brunt of attacks that are aimed at them, or by defusing dangerous situations.
As a provocateur, you specialize in turning your enemies against one another, giving your allies the advantage through careful use of deception.
You have learned to work well in concert with a team to provide the best reconnaissance and cover as much ground as possible.
You have demonstrated that you are a highly skilled and capable soldier for the Republic and work well in a commando squad.
You seek to overthrow the system and are adept at being a monkey wrench in the cogs of society, but often at the cost of others' rights, freedoms, and lives.
You are an expert in the use of Jet Packs. You can use this form of transport to perform specialized aerial assaults and maneuvers.
Scoundrels find ways to slip through fights of any size, even when the odds are against them.
You are skilled at improvising weapons, handling Explosives, and disrupting the enemy.
Your attunement to The Force grants you uncanny powers of perception.

Seyugi Dervishes are masters of Unarmed combat augmented by their control over The Force, and they traditionally hire themselves out as contract assassins. Their Force abilities allow them to move unseen and to make devastating, lightning-quick assaults on their targets.

records.name: Shaper of Kro Var Talent Tree

attrs.availability_text:
Tradition Talent Tree
(The Shapers of Kro Var)
attrs.summary: The Shapers of Kro Var are deeply in touch with the four classic elements of air, earth, fire, and water. They use The Force to manipulate these elements at a fundamental level, creating impressive effects, such as ripping stone, walls of solid wind, and gouts of flame. The Talents listed here are a small fraction of the "spells" that these primitive Force-users are capable of using.
You manipulate Yuuzhan Vong Biotech in new ways, molding it to your own ends and making it more effective.
You are an expert at long-range combat, using the inherent advantage of a Rifle to win the day.
You are trained in the Shockboxing fighting style and can use your fists to devastate your enemies.
You have learned the alchemical arts of the ancient Sith Lords and can fill objects and creatures with the power of The Dark Side.
The Sith use terror to lead their troops, and Sith commanders have few compunctions about making examples of underlings.
The Sith believe in order through tyranny, conspiring to annihilate The Jedi and everything they stand for.
You excel at complex tasks and are always called upon when your allies need something done quickly and done right.
You move like a ghost through the HoloNet and can hack into enemy mainframes and computer systems with astonishing grace.
Smuggling is part skill, part talent, part luck. The most notorious smugglers in the galaxy get along by making use of their quick wits and savvy.
You pron the space lanes seeking wealth, fame, adventure, or something more. You're also pretty good with Vehicles in general.
You have become more specialized than other Droids of the same or a similar model.
Scouts are often capable of getting into areas unseen, and they make excellent spies thanks to their survival instincts and aptitude for stealth.
You are a capable military leader who can issue orders to a squad of soldiers with poise and efficiency.
You are an expert at small-unit tactics, leading a small group of allies into battle as a cohesive unit.
You are an expert at leading a squadron of smaller Vehicles into combat as a unit.
You're not just good at what you do, you're the best. Failure is but a stumbling block, and great success always follows.
You have mastered the art of surveillance, transforming the information you gather with scouting into a distinct advantage on the battlefield.

attrs.availability_text: Scout, Enforcer, Medic, Outlaw, Pathfinder, Vanguard
attrs.summary: As an explorer of dangerous places, you are trained to react to danger swiftly and adroitly, as well as navigate difficult terrain and reduce damage.
You have mastered the art of mental manipulation, using The Force to touch, read, and affect the minds of others with ease.
Charlatans are masters of misdirection, confusion, and trickery.
In war, soldiers stand side by side against deadly foes, and you have learned how to keep yourself and your comrades alive in battle.
You can construct small, disposable, automated turrets.
The masters of The Tyia seek out Harmony while eschewing Discord. A Tyia Adept connects to The Force in search of unity, and attempts to align their body and spirit with the galaxy.
You have advanced training in one or more martial art form and have turned your body into a lethal weapon.
As an expert in the art of scouting enemy formations, you are a valuable asset to any military force.
You are known for your ability to adapt to any situation, heedless of adversity.
You have been from one side of the galaxy to the other and have fought on more planets than most people visit in a lifetime.

records.name: Warden of the Sky Talent Tree

attrs.availability_text:
Tradition Talent Tree
(The Wardens of the Sky)
attrs.summary: Wardens of the Sky use a combination of martial arts and Force Powers to help keep the space lanes safe. As a Warden of the Sky, you rely on nothing more than your own body to serve as a weapon against predators.
Warriors draw upon their natural aggressiveness, powerful bodies, and fighting abilities to defeat their enemies.
You are skilled at wielding a variety of weapons and can wield choice weapons with deadly precision and force.
You are highly trained at using specific weapons.

The White Current guides The Fallanassi to use its power to benefit everything and everyone around them, as well as to protect themselves. Those who succeed in channeling the White Current often display powers with surprising effects.
Yuuzhan Vong Biotechnology remains available in some parts of the galaxy, although its legally dubious. You have become specialized in its manipulation.
Zeison Sha talented enough to become Warriors focus their powers on manipulating the objects around them. They are also masters of their signature weapon: the Discblade.
